newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Five Israeli soldiers wounded in Lebanon clash.
newsitem.headline: Five Israeli soldiers wounded in Lebanon clash.

text.p: Five Israeli soldiers were wounded in a clash with guerrillas in south Lebanon on Wednesday, Israeli security sources said.
The sources said the incident occurred inside Israel's 15 km (nine mile) wide south Lebanon occupation zone. An Israeli army spokesman said he was checking the report.
Earlier on Wednesday three Israeli soldiers were wounded by a mine explosion in the border zone occupied by the Jewish state since 1985.
No other details of the later clash were immediately available.
Around 1,000 Israeli troops patrol the Jewish state's south Lebanon occupation zone carved out to protect its northern border from infiltrations and rocket attacks.

Militants of the Islamic Hizbollah (Party of God) have fought a guerrilla war to oust Israel from the zone. The group claimed responsiblity for an attack on Israeli and allied militia posts on Tuesday during which some shells slammed into two villages in the occupation zone.
